title: Machine and Terminal
author: Emrys Nakamura
blurb: Tamsin Brightwater, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
